name: Kimberly Summers
why: Her own sophomore class portrait, cut at the scan's native size.
caption_quote: KIMBERLY SUMMERS, Louisville - third of six in the second row of the sophomore grid, the row's names running Stich, Stinson, Summers, Swallows, Sylvester, Taylor in alphabetical order left to right

src.label: 1987 Talisman, p. 345, sophomore portraits; the volume's index gives her pp. 114, 119 and 345, and p. 114 is the student government page, which is what ties this face to the officer rather than to a namesake
